_comment: Original AstroVerse text. Planet-in-sign snippets (Mercury–Pluto), one planet per review batch. Tone and guardrails: docs/INTERPRETATION.md.

Aries.meaning: You tend to think fast and say what you mean. Quick decisions come easily, and slowing down to listen can make your ideas land even better.

Taurus.meaning: You tend to think things through slowly and carefully, and once you decide, you stick to it. People may trust your words because you rarely say things you don't mean.

Gemini.meaning: Your mind is quick, playful and always collecting new information. You may enjoy talking, texting and learning about many topics at once.

Cancer.meaning: You tend to think with your heart, remembering how things felt as much as what was said. You may be a gentle listener who picks up on moods no one mentions.

Leo.meaning: You tend to speak with warmth, confidence and a touch of drama. You may be a natural storyteller who can inspire and entertain a room.

Virgo.meaning: Your mind is sharp, organized and good with details. You may enjoy analyzing problems and finding practical ways to make things better.

Libra.meaning: You tend to think in terms of fairness, weighing every side before you speak. You may know how to say hard things kindly.
challenges: Agreeing just to keep the peace

Scorpio.meaning: Your mind is deep, focused and good at finding what's hidden. You may prefer meaningful conversations to small talk and keep some thoughts to yourself.

Sagittarius.meaning: You tend to think big and love ideas about life, faith, travel and the future. You may speak honestly and with humor, though small details can slip past you.

Capricorn.meaning: Your mind is practical, serious and focused on what works. You may think in plans and steps, and people often take your words seriously.

Aquarius.meaning: You tend to think in original ways and enjoy new ideas, technology and big questions about people and society. You may spot solutions others miss.
challenges: Arguing for the sake of it

Pisces.meaning: Your mind is imaginative and intuitive, often thinking in pictures, feelings and stories. You may understand people without needing many words.

Aries.meaning: In love you tend to be direct, eager and drawn to excitement. You may enjoy the thrill of a new connection, and patience helps your feelings grow deeper over time.

Taurus.meaning: You tend to love in a steady, loyal and affectionate way, showing care through time, comfort and small gifts. You may value security and simple pleasures shared with someone you trust.

Gemini.meaning: You tend to fall for minds first, and good conversation can feel like the best kind of closeness. You may enjoy variety, fun and a partner who is also a friend.

Cancer.meaning: You tend to love in a nurturing, protective way and want a relationship that feels like home. You may show affection by caring for people and remembering what matters to them.

Leo.meaning: You tend to love generously and with your whole heart. You may enjoy romance, big gestures and feeling truly appreciated by the people you care for.

Virgo.meaning: You tend to show love through helpful acts and attention to small needs. You may take your time to trust, but your care is practical and real.

Libra.meaning: You tend to value harmony, fairness and beauty in love and friendship. You may be a gracious, considerate partner who works hard to keep the peace.

Scorpio.meaning: You tend to love deeply and want closeness that is honest and wholehearted. You may value loyalty above everything, and trust grows best when both people also feel free.

Sagittarius.meaning: You tend to love with optimism and a sense of adventure. You may need a partner who shares your curiosity and gives you room to grow.

Capricorn.meaning: You tend to take love seriously and show it through commitment and support. You may be slow to open up, but once you do, you are steady and dependable.

Aquarius.meaning: You tend to value friendship, freedom and honesty in love. You may be drawn to people who are a little different and who respect your independence.

Pisces.meaning: You tend to love with compassion and a romantic imagination. You may be gentle and giving, and clear boundaries help your kindness stay healthy.
